What's your return and refund policy?
Because we sell food products, we cannot accept blanket return requests for items like dried or freeze-dried fruits, vegetables, beans, or soy protein once the box has been opened and handled, as we cannot resell them.
If you decide you do not want your food items, you must refuse the package at delivery so it is returned to us unopened. Returned unopened shipments are subject to a 15% restocking fee plus round-trip shipping charges.
Unused non-food items or general food storage supplies are eligible for return, but you must contact us first to receive a Return Authorization number before sending anything back.
